=== a linked frame
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.globl f
f:
	.loc 1 3 0
	.cfi_startproc
	link.w %fp, #0
	.cfi_offset 14, -8
	.cfi_def_cfa 14, 8
	.loc 1 4 5 prologue_end
	moveml %d2-%d3/%a2, -(%sp)
	.cfi_offset %d2, -20
	.cfi_offset %d3, -16
	.cfi_offset %a2, -12
	.cfi_offset fp0, -32
	.cfi_register %pc, %a0
	.cfi_same_value sp
	moveq #0, %d0
	.loc 1 5 1 epilogue_begin
	moveml (%sp)+, %d2-%d3/%a2
	unlk %fp
	.cfi_def_cfa %sp, 4
	rts
	.cfi_endproc
=== code counted in words
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
f:
	.loc 1 3 0
	nop
	.loc 1 4 5
	.skip 68
	nop
	.loc 1 5 1
	rts
